dedupe_keys.name: kuala lumpur one minute global horizontal irradiance 2025

description: The public Mendeley release contains one CSV for each day of 2025 with one-minute global horizontal irradiance at the UCSI University Kuala Lumpur campus. Measurements were collected from 07:00 through 18:59 local time using a CMP3 pyranometer and a standalone solar-powered logger. The article reports 259,858 observed readings from 262,800 expected daytime minutes; 2,942 gaps, or 1.12 percent, were filled by linear interpolation. The repository lists 365 daily files and CC BY 4.0 terms. Coverage is one urban Malaysian site and daytime only, without wind or other meteorological variables. A limitation is that interpolated minutes are estimates, and one annual series cannot establish climatic extremes elsewhere. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is testing minute-scale PV output variation, storage sizing or ramp-rate controls. data-nsrdb-national-solar-radiation-database is a related irradiance source with wider coverage and different sampling. The CSV values, interpolation flags and uncertainty calculations were not independently checked. No measurement file was downloaded.
